packets.name: 1-valibot-message-prefix-reference
packets.delivery:
Implemented optional `messagePrefix` support across Valibot configuration and issue generation.

Changes:
- Added `messagePrefix?: string` to the public `Config` type.
- Included `messagePrefix` in global configuration and per-parse merging, preserving an explicit per-call empty string override.
- Applied the effective prefix exactly once after custom-message precedence and callback evaluation, so callbacks receive the original message.
- Preserved nested, union, sync, async, abort, issue structure, and successful parse behavior.

Checks run:
- `npm run test:study:regression` — passed, 4/4 tests.
- `npm run test:study:feature` — passed, 4/4 tests.
- `npm run test:study:types` — completed successfully with exit code 0; the runner reported no test counters.

The supplied checks cover selected feature/regression cases and source types, not the complete upstream suite.

packets.name: 1-valibot-message-prefix-compiler
packets.delivery:
Implemented optional `messagePrefix` configuration across Valibot’s public `Config` type, global configuration resolution, and issue generation. Per-call values override global values—including `''`; prefixes are applied once after custom-message precedence and callback evaluation, so callbacks receive unprefixed messages. Sync/async and nested issue behavior is covered by the supplied study feature checks. Updated the global-config test fixture for the new configuration shape.

Checks run:
- `npm run test:study:regression` — passed, 4/4 tests.
- `npm run test:study:feature` — passed, 4/4 tests.
- `npm run test:study:types` — passed.

The supplied checks are targeted and do not represent the complete upstream test suite; broader suite coverage remains unknown.
